title: What Cloud Control is and where it runs
summary: Cloud Control (cloudctl) is one ooRexx command line for the ED209 estate's cloud machines and cloud firewalls across Oracle (OCI), Azure, AWS, Google (GCP) and Vultr; Clouvider (ed209f) has no cloud firewall plug-in, so its host firewall carries XTP. Commands: PROVIDER machine list|create|start|stop|reboot|destroy, PROVIDER firewall list|allow|revoke|reconcile, xtp show|NODE|all, discover, ops, hours, check. Every mutation is a PLAN until --apply; destroy also needs --confirm. Each run goes resolve -> rules (STOP/WARN/INFO buckets) -> observe (read-only) -> plan -> apply -> ledger (var/ops-YYYYMM.tsv) with events through oorexx_logging. The live copy is on Tom Dyer's workstation in ~/alchemy-autobuild/cloudctl, called as ./cloudctl-rx.sh from ~/alchemy-autobuild; it holds the live registry (etc/machines, etc/accounts) that the package leaves out.

invariants: Observe before plan: a failed read is a STOP, never read as absent
The live registry never leaves the workstation
